title: Two-variable naturality of the native small-model Hom comparison
statement: The pointwise comparison of [def-sf-native-frobenius-hom-comparison] commutes with source precomposition and target postcomposition: E.map(Hom(f,g)) followed by h at the target pair equals h at the source pair followed by nativeHom.map(E.map(f).op,E.map(g)).

proof.text: Use the naturality square of inverseNativeHomComparison at the pair (Q.map(f).op,Q.map(g)). Normalize the ordinary curried Hom map with homObjMap_comp_homObjMap. Compose this square with the slice-unlifting square homIso_naturality, using the functor map-composition equations and associativity, as formalized by mapIso_comp_naturality.

lean.statement:
theorem homComparison_naturality (H : AdicModuleHomComparisonCore l Y)
    {M M' N N' : TwistedActionRingedSite.Modules (ring Y l)}
    (f : M' ⟶ M) (g : N ⟶ N') :
    (equivalence Y l).functor.map (SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := ring Y l) f g) ≫
        (homComparison Y l H M' N').hom =
      (homComparison Y l H M N).hom ≫
        (nativeHom Y l).map (((equivalence Y l).functor.map f).op,
          (equivalence Y l).functor.map g)
